author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
This QuickBooks Time tutorial shows you how to stop wasting hours on manual tracking and use QuickBooks time tools inside QuickBooks Payroll to manage employee hours more accurately. ⏰ Sign up for Time Tracking here ➜ https://qbpayroll.kevinstratvert.com/ 

First, you’ll see how QuickBooks Time fits into the payroll setup process, including choosing the right payroll plan, understanding what Premium and Elite unlock, and getting your account ready for real-world time tracking. 

Next, you’ll learn the QuickBooks Time basics, from navigating the Time app and pinning the tools you use most to adding an employee, inviting them into the QuickBooks Workforce app, and getting their account ready to clock in. 

Then, you’ll watch how employees can use the QuickBooks Workforce app to clock in, clock out, track past time, and optionally capture location data so you can see how mobile time tracking works in practice.
